a2.text: A trader asks why abundance would necessarily be shared fairly.

b1.text: The village reflects on drought, illness, and the vulnerability of supply routes.

b2.text: A child asks why anyone would go hungry if nearby people had more than they needed; the adults offer no easy answer.
